details: Casadei's over-the-knee boots in supple stretch nappa, will elevate any outfit. This pair has been made in Italy from stretch material for a flexible, exacting fit and set on a towering stiletto heel and a pointed toe that makes your legs look longer.
The seductive soul of the over-the-knee stretch suede boots is highlighted by the dizzying stiletto heel. The style is perfect for any occasion and enhances the female figure with a glam touch.
Casadei's iconic platform designs with skyscarper heels are concived to accentuate the feminine silhouette, enchancing sensuality and elegance.

The statement platform in black patent leather adds a lavish touch to your styling. They boast the house’s inherent elegance, utmost quality and irresistible allure. The towering heel is balanced by the platform and the ankle strap holds the feet in place.
